letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile, my daily sunrise. Even as the calendar flips—today feels like a gentle reminder of the love that blossomed on that unforgettable February day. I cherish every moment, from desert dunes to spice‑laden streets, and I can’t wait for countless more adventures with my cutie by my side. All my love, forever yours.
poem:
In desert sands or monsoon rain,  
Your love’s the compass, steady, plain.  
Together we dance, heartbeats in sync,  
Forever yours, more than you think.
